violations.why: irq_inlet (priority 3) can preempt irq_umbra (priority 2) between the two reads of v_coral and change it, so the reads may see different values.
irq_raptor (priority 4) can preempt irq_umbra between the two reads of v_onyx and write it, so the reads may differ.
v_sable++ in irq_delta is a read followed by a write. irq_ridge (priority 5) can preempt between them and write v_sable, and that write is then overwritten (lost update).
